/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Infe.name: Fass Residue
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Infe.description:
A chunk of the wyrm Fass, collected after his explosive death in the Cambion Drift. Used to attract Glutinox on the surface during Vome, Ostimyr at surface hotspots during Fass, and Vitreospina in caves during Fass/Vome.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos while Vome is active
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Infe.descriptionEn:
A chunk of the wyrm Fass, collected after his explosive death in the Cambion Drift. Used to attract Glutinox on the surface during Vome, Ostimyr at surface hotspots during Fass, and Vitreospina in caves during Fass/Vome.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos while Vome is active
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Infe.descriptionZh:
属于蛟龙'混乱'的一大块东西，是在他爆炸死亡后收集的。可以用来吸引'秩序'期间地面中的狍鸮胶蛳、'混乱'期间地面鱼点中的奥斯蒂剑鱼，以及'秩序'/'混乱'期间洞穴中的璃化脊鳎。

获取地点：'秩序'活跃时的火卫二魔胎之境

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Infe.name: Processed Fass Residue
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Infe.description:
Matter from the body of the Wyrm Fass, purged of toxins, and rendered usefully. Used to attract Aquapulmo and Flagellocanth in Cambion Drift surface hotspots, Aquapulmo only during Vome.

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Infe.descriptionEn:
Matter from the body of the Wyrm Fass, purged of toxins, and rendered usefully. Used to attract Aquapulmo and Flagellocanth in Cambion Drift surface hotspots, Aquapulmo only during Vome.

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Infe.descriptionZh:
来自于蛟龙'混乱'身上的物质，清除了毒素后变得有用了。可以用来吸引魔胎之境地面鱼点中的水肺和须腔棘鱼、'秩序'期间的水肺。

从殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Orok.name: Vome Residue
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Orok.description:
A gobbet of raw flesh, fallen from the wyrm Vome in her death spasm. Used to attract Chondricord and Duriod in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Fass and Vome.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos while Fass is active
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Orok.descriptionEn:
A gobbet of raw flesh, fallen from the wyrm Vome in her death spasm. Used to attract Chondricord and Duriod in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Fass and Vome.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos while Fass is active
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Orok.descriptionZh:
在蛟龙'秩序'的死亡痉挛时，从她身上掉下来的一块生肉。可以用来吸引'秩序'/'混乱'期间魔胎之境洞穴鱼点中的骨锥琼鲷和韧铠灵鲷。

获取地点：'混乱'活跃时的火卫二魔胎之境

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Orok.name: Processed Vome Residue
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Orok.description:
The flesh of Vome, refined, and ready for use. Used to attract Myxostomata in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Vome.

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Orok.descriptionEn:
The flesh of Vome, refined, and ready for use. Used to attract Myxostomata in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Vome.

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Orok.descriptionZh:
'秩序'的肉，经过提炼且随时可用。可以用来吸引'秩序'期间魔胎之境洞穴鱼点中的独角米索鳎。

从殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/CaveCon.name: Mirewinder Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/CaveCon.description:
This bait is composed of aromatic tetraxin that is known to attract Mirewinders, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis cave hotspots.

Obtained via The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/CaveCon.descriptionEn:
This bait is composed of aromatic tetraxin that is known to attract Mirewinders, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis cave hotspots.

Obtained via The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/CaveCon.descriptionZh:
这种鱼饵由芳香性的四氢素组成，能够吸引污泥绕环者，一种出没于山洞鱼点中的伺服鱼。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/CaveCon.name: Charamote Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/CaveCon.description:
This bait is synthesized from complex hexophenol that is known to attract Charamotes, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis cave hotspots.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/CaveCon.descriptionEn:
This bait is synthesized from complex hexophenol that is known to attract Charamotes, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis cave hotspots.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/CaveCon.descriptionZh:
这种鱼饵由复杂的己苯酚合成，能够吸引重筑虾，一种可于山洞鱼点中找到的伺服鱼。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/CaveCon.name: Synathid Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/CaveCon.description:
This bait is synthesized from specialized A-disulphex-A compounds that are known to attract Synathid, a legendarily rare Servofish found only in Orb Vallis cave hotspots.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/CaveCon.descriptionEn:
This bait is synthesized from specialized A-disulphex-A compounds that are known to attract Synathid, a legendarily rare Servofish found only in Orb Vallis cave hotspots.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/CaveCon.descriptionZh:
这种鱼饵由特制的A－二硫科斯－A化合物合成，能够吸引海龙，一种可于山洞鱼点中找到的传奇稀有伺服鱼。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/Generic.name: Broad-Spectrum Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/Generic.description:
A simple cocktail of short-chain polymers and contaminants. Easily detected by rudimentary Servofish in the Orb Vallis under all conditions, but ignored by more specialized models. Good for Sapcaddies (found in the lake), and Tinks and Brickies (found in ponds).

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/Generic.descriptionEn:
A simple cocktail of short-chain polymers and contaminants. Easily detected by rudimentary Servofish in the Orb Vallis under all conditions, but ignored by more specialized models. Good for Sapcaddies (found in the lake), and Tinks and Brickies (found in ponds).

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/Generic.descriptionZh:
一种短链聚合物及污染物的简单混合。在所有情况下都能轻易被奥布山谷中基本的伺服鱼侦测到，但是被更特殊型的伺服鱼所忽略。适用于液集者（可在湖泊找到）、修补机和砖瓦匠（可在池塘找到）。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/LakeCon.name: Kriller Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/LakeCon.description:
This bait is synthesized from Methacalcene-1 that is known to attract Krillers, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis lakes during warm weather.

Obtained via The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/LakeCon.descriptionEn:
This bait is synthesized from Methacalcene-1 that is known to attract Krillers, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis lakes during warm weather.

Obtained via The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/LakeCon.descriptionZh:
这种鱼饵由甲烷活性钙-1合成，可以吸引磷虾杀手，一种可在温暖天气中于湖泊中找到的伺服鱼。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/LakeCon.name: Longwinder Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/LakeCon.description:
This bait is synthesized from beryzene that is known to attract Longwinders, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis lake hotspots during warm weather.

Obtained via The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/LakeCon.descriptionEn:
This bait is synthesized from beryzene that is known to attract Longwinders, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis lake hotspots during warm weather.

Obtained via The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/LakeCon.descriptionZh:
这种鱼饵由铍苯合成，用于吸引长型环绕者，一种可在温暖天气的湖泊中找到的伺服鱼。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/PondCon.name: Narrow-Spectrum Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/PondCon.description:
This endochlor/dionium melange attracts both Recasters and Eye-Eyes, Servofish found in Orb Vallis ponds. The Eye-Eye shows up during warm weather and Recasters shows up at Hot Spots during cool weather.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/PondCon.descriptionEn:
This endochlor/dionium melange attracts both Recasters and Eye-Eyes, Servofish found in Orb Vallis ponds. The Eye-Eye shows up during warm weather and Recasters shows up at Hot Spots during cool weather.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/PondCon.descriptionZh:
这种内型联氯 / 釱元素的混合物可以吸引续播机和目－目这类可以在池塘内找到的伺服鱼。目－目会在温暖天气时出现，续播机则在天气寒冷时出现在鱼点中。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/PondCon.name: Tromyzon Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/PondCon.description:
This bait is synthesized from long-chain LS-74 compounds that are known to attract Tromyzon, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis pond hotspots during cool weather.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/PondCon.descriptionEn:
This bait is synthesized from long-chain LS-74 compounds that are known to attract Tromyzon, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis pond hotspots during cool weather.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/PondCon.descriptionZh:
这种鱼饵由长链的 LS-74 化合物所合成，可以吸引多目鳗，一种可以在寒冷天气中池塘鱼点中找到的伺服鱼。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/BothRareFishB.name: Murkray Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/BothRareFishB.description:
This bait is composed of materials that are known to attract Murkrays, a fish found only in Plains of Eidolon ocean hotspots during both day and night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/BothRareFishB.descriptionEn:
This bait is composed of materials that are known to attract Murkrays, a fish found only in Plains of Eidolon ocean hotspots during both day and night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/BothRareFishB.descriptionZh:
这种鱼饵是由已知能吸引阴暗鳐的材料所组成。这种鱼无论日夜皆只能在海洋鱼点中寻获。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/BothUncommonF.name: Twilight Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/BothUncommonF.description:
This bait attracts predatory fish that are active in the Plains of Eidolon during either day or night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Attracts Sharrac and Karkina in the ocean.
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/BothUncommonF.descriptionEn:
This bait attracts predatory fish that are active in the Plains of Eidolon during either day or night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Attracts Sharrac and Karkina in the ocean.
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/BothUncommonF.descriptionZh:
这种鱼饵可以吸引白天或晚上活跃的捕食者鱼类。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。吸引海洋中的鲨客和卡其那。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/GenericFishBa.name: Peppered Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/GenericFishBa.description:
This bait attracts fish that are active in the Plains of Eidolon during the day.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Attracts Mawfish and Charc Eels in the lake; Khut-Khut, Yogwun, and Mortus Lungfish in ponds; and Goopolla and Tralok in the ocean.
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/GenericFishBa.descriptionEn:
This bait attracts fish that are active in the Plains of Eidolon during the day.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Attracts Mawfish and Charc Eels in the lake; Khut-Khut, Yogwun, and Mortus Lungfish in ponds; and Goopolla and Tralok in the ocean.
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/GenericFishBa.descriptionZh:
这种诱饵可以吸引白天在夜灵平野活动的鱼类。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。吸引湖中的喉鱼和查克鳗；池塘中的库特-库特、约格温和摩图斯肺鱼；以及海洋中的古泊拉和塔洛。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/NightLegendar.name: Glappid Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/NightLegendar.description:
This bait is composed of exotic materials that are known to attract the elusive Glappid, a fish found only in Plains of Eidolon ocean hotspots during the night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/NightLegendar.descriptionEn:
This bait is composed of exotic materials that are known to attract the elusive Glappid, a fish found only in Plains of Eidolon ocean hotspots during the night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/NightLegendar.descriptionZh:
这种鱼饵是由已知能吸引神出鬼没的盖拉佩德的奇特材料所组成，这种鱼只能在夜间夜灵平野的海洋鱼点中寻获。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/NightRareFish.name: Norg Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/NightRareFish.description:

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/NightRareFish.descriptionZh:
这种鱼饵是由已知能吸引诺格的材料所组成。这种鱼只能在夜间夜灵平野中的湖泊鱼点中寻获。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/NightRareFish.name: Cuthol Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/NightRareFish.description:
This bait is composed of materials that are known to attract Cuthols, a fish found only in Plains of Eidolon pond hotspots during the night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Bas.name: A Fishing Spear

The barbed prongs on this fishing spear make it easier to catch fish with smooth skin. 

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). This spear is most effective on the following Plains of Eidolon fish:
Charc Eel
Cuthol
Goopolla
Murkray
Sharrac
Yogwun

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。这根鱼叉对以下夜灵平野的鱼类最有效：

克苏尔
古泊拉
阴暗鳐
鲨客

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Bet.name: Beta Corruptor
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Bet.description: Inert on its own this corruptor is highly effective if mixed with its Alpha counterpart. Properly mixed, these will destabilize Fomorian Reactors much faster than their Stable counterparts. This volatile item cannot be simultaneously equipped with Alpha Corruptors. Recommended for Tenno operating as a team.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Bet.descriptionEn: Inert on its own this corruptor is highly effective if mixed with its Alpha counterpart. Properly mixed, these will destabilize Fomorian Reactors much faster than their Stable counterparts. This volatile item cannot be simultaneously equipped with Alpha Corruptors. Recommended for Tenno operating as a team.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Bet.descriptionZh: 这污染物单独时属于惰性，当与 ALPHA 污染物混合时会产生极高的效果，适当的混合会破坏巨人战舰反应堆的平衡，比 STABLE 污染物来的迅速，这个不稳定的物品不能同时间与 ALPHA 污染物一起携带，推荐给 Tenno 合作团队。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Bro.name: Vapor Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Bro.description: A replicant cloned from a Warframe which can be deployed to assist Tenno on their missions.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Bro.descriptionEn: A replicant cloned from a Warframe which can be deployed to assist Tenno on their missions.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Bro.descriptionZh: 一个战甲的克隆复制品，可以部署来协助 Tenno 执行任务。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cam.name: Remote Observer
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cam.description: Deploys a short-lived remote camera that overrides your Warframe optics

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cam.descriptionZh: 设置一个短暂存在的遥控镜头，取代战甲的视角

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cha.name: Charger Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cha.description: Deploys a CHARGER EXIMUS unit to fight for you.

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cha.descriptionZh: 设置一个为你战斗的疾冲卓越者魅影。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cle.name: Clem Clone
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cle.description: Deploys a clone of Clem to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cle.descriptionEn: Deploys a clone of Clem to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cle.descriptionZh: 部署一名 Clem 克隆人为你作战。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cor.name: Corrupted Bombard Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cor.description: Deploys a CORRUPTED BOMBARD unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cor.descriptionEn: Deploys a CORRUPTED BOMBARD unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cor.descriptionZh: 部置一名堕落轰击者单位为你战斗。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cor.description: Deploys a CORRUPTED LANCER EXIMUS unit to fight for you.

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.name: Passionate Void Offering
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.description: Give unto The Void a generous 100,000 credits.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.descriptionEn: Give unto The Void a generous 100,000 credits.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.descriptionZh: 献给虚空的一大笔 100，000 元现金。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.name: Faithful Void Offering
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.descriptionZh: 献给虚空的 10，000 元现金。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.name: Humble Void Offering
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.descriptionZh: 献给虚空的 1,000 元现金。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.name: On Call Crew
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.description: Call in a designated crew member for backup in non-Railjack missions.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.descriptionEn: Call in a designated crew member for backup in non-Railjack missions.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.descriptionZh: 在非航道星舰任务中，召唤一名指定的舰员作为后备支援。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fir.name: Grand Finale
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fir.description: Want a more spectacular fireworks display to show your patriotism? Celebrate in style with this single use consumable item.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fir.descriptionEn: Want a more spectacular fireworks display to show your patriotism? Celebrate in style with this single use consumable item.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fir.descriptionZh: 想要以更壮观的烟火表演来展现你的爱国精神吗？以这个仅限一次使用的道具来庆祝吧。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fir.name: Starburst
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fir.description: Celebrate the holiday with fireworks! Light up the sky with this single use consumable item.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fir.descriptionEn: Celebrate the holiday with fireworks! Light up the sky with this single use consumable item.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fir.descriptionZh: 用烟火来欢庆假日！以这个仅限一次使用的道具来点亮整片天空吧。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fom.name: Fomorian Disruptor
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fom.description: When activated, it disrupts a Fomorian core's Omega energy field, making it vulnerable. Also shields Tenno from Omega radiation.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fom.descriptionEn: When activated, it disrupts a Fomorian core's Omega energy field, making it vulnerable. Also shields Tenno from Omega radiation.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fom.descriptionZh: 启动时它会破坏巨人战舰核心的奥米伽能量力场，使其变得脆弱易损。并为暴露在奥米伽辐射中的 Tenno 提供庇护。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Gly.name: Glyph Prism
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Gly.description: Launches a magnetic prism to display your chosen Glyph. Only one may be deployed at a time, and charges are consumed on use.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Gly.descriptionEn: Launches a magnetic prism to display your chosen Glyph. Only one may be deployed at a time, and charges are consumed on use.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Gly.descriptionZh: 发射一道电磁光谱来展示你所选取的浮印。同一时间只能部署一个，并且一旦使用将消耗道具。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Gly.name: Glyph Prism
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Gly.description: Launches a magnetic prism to display your chosen Glyph. Only one may be deployed at a time, and charges are unlimited.

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Hun.name: Kinetic Siphon Trap
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Hun.description: Specialized trap for attracting and slowing the movement of synthesis targets.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Hun.descriptionEn: Specialized trap for attracting and slowing the movement of synthesis targets.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Hun.descriptionZh: 用以吸引或减缓结合目标移动速度的特制陷阱。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.name: Pherliac Pods
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.description: Creates 50x Pherliac Pods that releases powerful pheromones to attract the Infested.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.descriptionEn: Creates 50x Pherliac Pods that releases powerful pheromones to attract the Infested.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.descriptionZh: 制造 50个 费洛髂荚囊，能释出强烈的费洛蒙吸引感染者。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.name: Spari Spear
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.description:
Plumb the depths with this crafty fishing spear that's barely detectable to Infested and hybrid/Orokin fish. Due to its Infested aspect, it's one of the only known things that can pass through exocrine. 

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk. This spear is most effective on fish found in the Cambion Drift (Deimos).
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.descriptionEn:
Plumb the depths with this crafty fishing spear that's barely detectable to Infested and hybrid/Orokin fish. Due to its Infested aspect, it's one of the only known things that can pass through exocrine. 

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk. This spear is most effective on fish found in the Cambion Drift (Deimos).
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.descriptionZh:
用这把狡黠的鱼叉来探索深渊，感染者和感染者/奥罗金混种鱼类几乎无法察觉它。由于它的感染属性，它是已知的少数几种可以穿过外分泌液的鱼叉。 

从殁世幽都的'女儿'处获得。这根鱼叉对魔胎之境的鱼类最有效。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.name: Ebisu Spear
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.description:

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.description: Creates 50x Potent Pherliac Pods that releases powerful pheromones to attract the Infested.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.descriptionEn: Creates 50x Potent Pherliac Pods that releases powerful pheromones to attract the Infested.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.descriptionZh: 制造 50 个强效费洛髂荚囊，能释出强烈的费洛蒙吸引感染者。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.name: Antiserum Injector
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.description: Injects antiserum into Vaporizers or the user to prevent armor degradation.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.descriptionEn: Injects antiserum into Vaporizers or the user to prevent armor degradation.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.descriptionZh: 将抗血清注入雾化器或是使用者本身，可防止护甲被侵蚀。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Lib.name: Synthesis Scanner
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Lib.description: Synthesize a genetic data of the target and uploads it to the Sanctuary.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Lib.descriptionEn: Synthesize a genetic data of the target and uploads it to the Sanctuary.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Lib.descriptionZh: 结合目标的基因数据并将其上传至圣殿。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Mac.name: Scorpion Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Mac.description: Deploys a SCORPION EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Mac.descriptionEn: Deploys a SCORPION EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Mac.descriptionZh: 设置一个为你战斗的毒蝎卓越者魅影。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Map.name: Loc-Pin
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Map.description: A persistent waypoint marker for use with the world map. Coordinate your squad and track places of importance!
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Map.descriptionEn: A persistent waypoint marker for use with the world map. Coordinate your squad and track places of importance!
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Map.descriptionZh: 一种使用在世界地图中的持久性标记点。协调你的队伍并追踪一些重要的位置！

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.name: Nosam Cutter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.description:
Standard tool for cutting ore and gems out of stone.

Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.descriptionEn:
Standard tool for cutting ore and gems out of stone.

Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.descriptionZh:
从石头中切割矿石和宝石的标准的工具。

远离城镇中心，将有更高几率开采出稀有矿物。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.name: Focused Nosam Cutter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.description:
A more accurate variation of the Nosam Cutter.

Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.descriptionEn:
A more accurate variation of the Nosam Cutter.

Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.descriptionZh:
一款更精准的诺萨姆切割器变体。

远离城镇中心，将有更高几率开采出稀有矿物。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.name: Advanced Nosam Cutter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.description:
Enhanced with cybernetics, this tool is able to locate nearby gems and ore veins and has chance to retrieve Rare Gems on any Landscape.

Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.descriptionEn:
Enhanced with cybernetics, this tool is able to locate nearby gems and ore veins and has chance to retrieve Rare Gems on any Landscape.

Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.descriptionZh:
经过控制理论的升级，这把工具能够定位附近的宝石和矿脉，并有几率在任何地形中获取稀有宝石。

远离城镇中心，将有更高几率开采出稀有矿物。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.name: Sunpoint Plasma Drill
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.description:
Fast-ignition, high-intensity mining tool capable of extracting the rarest of materials with surgical precision.

Can be used to retrieve Rare Gems on any Landscape. Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.descriptionEn:
Fast-ignition, high-intensity mining tool capable of extracting the rarest of materials with surgical precision.

Can be used to retrieve Rare Gems on any Landscape. Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.descriptionZh:
这是一把快速点火、高强度的采矿工具，能够以外科手术般的精确度开采最稀有的矿物。

可在任何地形中获取稀有宝石。远离城镇中心，将有更高几率开采出稀有矿物。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Moa.name: Moa Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Moa.description: Deploys a MOA EXIMUS unit to fight for you.

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Moa.descriptionZh: 设置一个为你战斗的恐鸟卓越者魅影。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Nem.name: Requiem Ultimatum
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Nem.description: Provokes an immediate confrontation with your Kuva Lich or Sister of Parvos: an insult which cannot be ignored.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Nem.descriptionEn: Provokes an immediate confrontation with your Kuva Lich or Sister of Parvos: an insult which cannot be ignored.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Nem.descriptionZh: 引发与你的赤毒玄骸或帕尔沃斯姐妹的直接对抗：这是一种不容忽视的侮辱。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Pla.name: Cosmic Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Pla.description: A replicant cloned from a Warframe which can be deployed to assist Tenno on their missions.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Pla.descriptionEn: A replicant cloned from a Warframe which can be deployed to assist Tenno on their missions.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Pla.descriptionZh: 一个战甲的克隆复制品，可以部署来协助 Tenno 执行任务。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Raz.name: Razorback Cipher
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Raz.description: Used to bypass security systems that protect the Razorback's holding cell.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Raz.descriptionEn: Used to bypass security systems that protect the Razorback's holding cell.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Raz.descriptionZh: 用来绕开保护利刃豺狼收容室的安保系统。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rep.name: Omni
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rep.description: An Omni is a multi-use Railjack tool for extinguishing fires, grounding electrical hazards, and repairing hull ruptures. Use outside the Railjack to instantly recall back to the ship.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rep.descriptionEn: An Omni is a multi-use Railjack tool for extinguishing fires, grounding electrical hazards, and repairing hull ruptures. Use outside the Railjack to instantly recall back to the ship.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rep.descriptionZh: 万用工具是一种多功能的航道星舰工具，用于扑灭火灾、抢救电力事故，以及修复舰体破裂。在航道星舰外使用可立即被召回舰上。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rob.name: Shockprod Fishing Spear
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rob.description:
Purpose built to recover Servofish without damage. Delivers a disabling electromagnetic pulse after a successful hit if timed correctly.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna. This spear is most effective on Servofish found in the Orb Vallis (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rob.descriptionEn:
Purpose built to recover Servofish without damage. Delivers a disabling electromagnetic pulse after a successful hit if timed correctly.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna. This spear is most effective on Servofish found in the Orb Vallis (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rob.descriptionZh:
一种能够捕获伺服鱼，同时避免对其造成伤害的工具。若在恰当的时机命中目标，它就会释放出带有失能效果的电磁脉冲波。

从福尔图娜的操盘手处获得。这根鱼叉对奥布山谷（金星）的伺服鱼最有效。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rob.name: Stunna Fishing Spear
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rob.description:
Successful electromagnetic pulses radiate outward also disabling any nearby Servofish.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna. This spear is most effective on Servofish found in the Orb Vallis (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rob.descriptionEn:
Successful electromagnetic pulses radiate outward also disabling any nearby Servofish.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna. This spear is most effective on Servofish found in the Orb Vallis (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rob.descriptionZh:
成功发射的电磁脉冲往外散发同时瘫痪任何附近的伺服鱼。

从福尔图娜的操盘手处获得。这根鱼叉对奥布山谷（金星）的伺服鱼最有效。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rol.name: Roller Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rol.description: Deploys a ROLLER EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rol.descriptionEn: Deploys a ROLLER EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rol.descriptionZh: 设置一个为你战斗的滚子卓越者魅影。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sca.name: Codex Scanner
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sca.description: Samples a target of interest for later analysis in your Codex (25 charges).
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sca.descriptionEn: Samples a target of interest for later analysis in your Codex (25 charges).
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sca.descriptionZh: 抽样扫描感兴趣的目标到资料库，用于日后分析。（25个装）

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Shi.name: Shield Osprey Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Shi.description: Deploys a SHIELD OSPREY EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Shi.descriptionEn: Deploys a SHIELD OSPREY EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Shi.descriptionZh: 设置一个为你战斗的护盾鱼鹰卓越者魅影。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sil.name: Phase Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sil.description: A replicant cloned from a Warframe which can be deployed to assist Tenno on their missions.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sil.descriptionEn: A replicant cloned from a Warframe which can be deployed to assist Tenno on their missions.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sil.descriptionZh: 一个战甲的克隆复制品，可以部署来协助 Tenno 执行任务。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Ska.name: Desert Skate Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Ska.description: Deploys a DESERT SKATE unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Ska.descriptionEn: Deploys a DESERT SKATE unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Ska.descriptionZh: 设置一个为你战斗的沙漠鳐鱼魅影。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Spe.name: Lanzo Fishing Spear
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Spe.description:
The barbed prongs on this fishing spear make it easier to catch fish with smooth skin. 

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). This spear is most effective on the following Plains of Eidolon fish:
Charc Eel
Cuthol
Goopolla
Murkray
Sharrac
Yogwun
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Spe.descriptionEn:
The barbed prongs on this fishing spear make it easier to catch fish with smooth skin. 

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). This spear is most effective on the following Plains of Eidolon fish:
Charc Eel
Cuthol
Goopolla
Murkray
Sharrac
Yogwun
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Spe.descriptionZh:
这把鱼叉有着带倒刺的叉齿，便于抓住表皮光滑的鱼类。 

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。这根鱼叉对以下夜灵平野的鱼类最有效：
查克鳗
克苏尔
古泊拉
阴暗鳐
鲨客
约格温

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Spe.name: Tulok Fishing Spear
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Spe.description:
This fishing spear features a slender blade to puncture armored plates and carapaces. 

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). This spear is most effective on the following Plains of Eidolon fish:
Tralok
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Spe.descriptionEn:
This fishing spear features a slender blade to puncture armored plates and carapaces. 

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). This spear is most effective on the following Plains of Eidolon fish:
Tralok
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Spe.descriptionZh:
这把鱼叉有着细长的刃，可以穿透护甲板和外壳。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。这根鱼叉对以下夜灵平野的鱼类最有效：
塔洛

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Spe.name: Peram Fishing Spear
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Spe.description:
This fishing spear has multiple blades that allow it to pierce the hides of scaly fish. 

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). This spear is most effective on the following Plains of Eidolon fish:
Glappid
Khut-Khut
Mawfish
Mortus Lungfish
Norg
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Spe.descriptionEn:
This fishing spear has multiple blades that allow it to pierce the hides of scaly fish. 

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). This spear is most effective on the following Plains of Eidolon fish:
Glappid
Khut-Khut
Mawfish
Mortus Lungfish
Norg
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Spe.descriptionZh:
这把鱼叉有着多道刀刃，可以穿透有鳞鱼的外皮。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。这根鱼叉对以下夜灵平野的鱼类最有效：
盖拉佩德
库特-库特
喉鱼
摩图斯肺鱼
诺格

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sta.name: Stable Corruptor
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sta.description: Injected into a Fomorian Reactor this corruptor will imbalance the fuels. Critically imbalanced reactors will eventually implode, destroy the ship. Slow but effective, recommended for Solo Tenno.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sta.descriptionEn: Injected into a Fomorian Reactor this corruptor will imbalance the fuels. Critically imbalanced reactors will eventually implode, destroy the ship. Slow but effective, recommended for Solo Tenno.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sta.descriptionZh: 对巨人战舰反应堆注射这个污染物会造成燃料失调，失调的精密反应堆最后会发生聚爆，并摧毁船只，缓慢但是有效，推荐给独行 Tenno。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sta.name: Stalker Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sta.description: Deploys a clone of the Stalker to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sta.descriptionEn: Deploys a clone of the Stalker to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sta.descriptionZh: 部署一名追猎者分身为你作战。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sur.name: Surge Eximus Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sur.description: Deploys a clone of the Surge Eximus to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sur.descriptionEn: Deploys a clone of the Surge Eximus to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sur.descriptionZh: 部署一名电涌卓越者分身为你作战。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Val.name: Eros Arrow Skin
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Val.description: Show the enemy how much you care with the adorable Eros Arrow skin.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Val.descriptionEn: Show the enemy how much you care with the adorable Eros Arrow skin.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Val.descriptionZh: 借由可爱的爱神之箭外观来对你的敌人诉说他们在你心目中的地位。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TitaniaQuest/S.name: Sunrise Apothic
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TitaniaQuest/S.description: Creates an organic compound composed of rare plant species. Effects unknown.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TitaniaQuest/S.descriptionEn: Creates an organic compound composed of rare plant species. Effects unknown.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TitaniaQuest/S.descriptionZh: 制作一种由稀有植物合成的有机混合物。效果未知。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TitaniaQuest/S.name: Nightfall Apothic
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TitaniaQuest/S.description: Creates an organic compound composed of rare plant species. Effects unknown.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TitaniaQuest/S.descriptionEn: Creates an organic compound composed of rare plant species. Effects unknown.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TitaniaQuest/S.descriptionZh: 制作一种由稀有植物合成的有机混合物。效果未知。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TitaniaQuest/S.name: Twilight Apothic
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TitaniaQuest/S.description: Creates an organic compound composed of rare plant species. Effects unknown.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TitaniaQuest/S.descriptionEn: Creates an organic compound composed of rare plant species. Effects unknown.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TitaniaQuest/S.descriptionZh: 制作一种由稀有植物合成的有机混合物。效果未知。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Damag.name: Extinguished Dragon Key
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Damag.description:
Damage is greatly reduced while key is equipped.

Blueprint can be obtained via the Orokin Lab in a Clan Dojo.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Damag.descriptionEn:
Damage is greatly reduced while key is equipped.

Blueprint can be obtained via the Orokin Lab in a Clan Dojo.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Damag.descriptionZh:
装备该钥匙，伤害会极大的降低。

蓝图可以通过氏族道场中的奥罗金实验室获得。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Healt.name: Bleeding Dragon Key
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Healt.description:
Health is greatly reduced while key is equipped.

Blueprint can be obtained via the Orokin Lab in a Clan Dojo.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Healt.descriptionEn:
Health is greatly reduced while key is equipped.

Blueprint can be obtained via the Orokin Lab in a Clan Dojo.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Healt.descriptionZh:
装备该钥匙，生命会极大的降低。

蓝图可以通过氏族道场中的奥罗金实验室获得。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Shiel.name: Decaying Dragon Key
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Shiel.description:
Shields are greatly reduced while key is equipped. Full Shield Gate duration is capped at 0.33s.

Blueprint can be obtained via the Orokin Lab in a Clan Dojo.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Shiel.descriptionEn:
Shields are greatly reduced while key is equipped. Full Shield Gate duration is capped at 0.33s.

Blueprint can be obtained via the Orokin Lab in a Clan Dojo.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Shiel.descriptionZh:
在装备钥匙时，护盾会大幅减少。满护盾保险持续时间的上限会限定在 0.33 秒。

蓝图可以通过氏族道场中的奥罗金实验室获得。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Speed.name: Hobbled Dragon Key
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Speed.description:
Speed is greatly reduced while key is equipped.

Blueprint can be obtained via the Orokin Lab in a Clan Dojo.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Speed.descriptionEn:
Speed is greatly reduced while key is equipped.

Blueprint can be obtained via the Orokin Lab in a Clan Dojo.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Speed.descriptionZh:
装备该钥匙，速度会极大的降低。

蓝图可以通过氏族道场中的奥罗金实验室获得。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/CatbrowVampire.name: Vasca Curative
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/CatbrowVampire.description: Known as 'lisau heisah' by the Ostrons, this is a traditionally-brewed remedy for the Vasca virus. Once applied any infected Kavats within a short radius are cured.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/CatbrowVampire.descriptionEn: Known as 'lisau heisah' by the Ostrons, this is a traditionally-brewed remedy for the Vasca virus. Once applied any infected Kavats within a short radius are cured.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/CatbrowVampire.descriptionZh: 这是一种用传统方式调制而成的噬血病毒治疗剂，Ostron 人称之为'lisau heisah'。一旦使用，小范围内所有被感染的库娃都会得到治愈。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Cipher.name: Cipher
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Cipher.description: Single-use device used for auto-hacking the lockdown control panels.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Cipher.descriptionEn: Single-use device used for auto-hacking the lockdown control panels.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Cipher.descriptionZh: 自动入侵被锁定控制面板的一次性道具。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamAmmoTo.name: Squad Ammo Restore (Medium)
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamAmmoTo.description: Restores 2x Primary and Secondary Ammo Pick Up Amount every 15s for 60s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamAmmoTo.descriptionEn: Restores 2x Primary and Secondary Ammo Pick Up Amount every 15s for 60s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamAmmoTo.descriptionZh: 每 15 秒恢复 2 倍主要和次要弹药拾取量，持续 60 秒。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamEnergy.name: Squad Energy Restore (Medium)
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamEnergy.description: Restores Energy to all squad members. Pulses 50 Energy every 5s for 20s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamEnergy.descriptionEn: Restores Energy to all squad members. Pulses 50 Energy every 5s for 20s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamEnergy.descriptionZh: 恢复全团队的能量。每次脉冲恢复 50 点能量。脉冲间隔 5 秒，共计 20 秒。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamHealTo.name: Squad Health Restore (Medium)
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamHealTo.description: Restores Health to all squad members. Pulses 100 Health every 5s for 20s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamHealTo.descriptionEn: Restores Health to all squad members. Pulses 100 Health every 5s for 20s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamHealTo.descriptionZh: 恢复全团队的生命值。每次脉冲恢复 100 点生命。脉冲间隔 5 秒，共计 20 秒。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamShield.name: Squad Shield Restore (Medium)
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamShield.description: Restores Shields to all squad members. Pulses 100 Shield every 7.5s for 30s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamShield.descriptionEn: Restores Shields to all squad members. Pulses 100 Shield every 7.5s for 30s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamShield.descriptionZh: 恢复全团队的护盾值。每次脉冲恢复 100 点护盾。脉冲间隔 7.5 秒，共计 30 秒。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ErsatzSummon.name: Kaithe Summon
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ErsatzSummon.description: Summon and instantly mount a Kaithe while in free roam missions.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ErsatzSummon.descriptionEn: Summon and instantly mount a Kaithe while in free roam missions.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ErsatzSummon.descriptionZh: 在自由漫游任务中召唤并立即骑上绝灵骥。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/HeavyWeaponSum.name: Archgun Deployer
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/HeavyWeaponSum.description: Deploy the selected archwing gun in any atmospheric environment using this gear item.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/HeavyWeaponSum.descriptionEn: Deploy the selected archwing gun in any atmospheric environment using this gear item.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/HeavyWeaponSum.descriptionZh: 使用此装备道具来在任何大气环境下使用选定的曲翼枪械。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/HoverboardSumm.name: K-Drive Launcher
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/HoverboardSumm.description: Summons a K-Drive for use during free roam missions
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/HoverboardSumm.descriptionEn: Summons a K-Drive for use during free roam missions
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/HoverboardSumm.descriptionZh: 在自由漫游任务中召唤 K 式悬浮板使用

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetAirSuppor.name: Air Support Charges
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetAirSuppor.description: Charges consumed by Landing Craft Air Support.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetAirSuppor.descriptionEn: Charges consumed by Landing Craft Air Support.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetAirSuppor.descriptionZh: 登陆艇空中支援会消耗呼叫器。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetAmmoDrop.name: Squad Ammo Restore (Medium)
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetAmmoDrop.description: Restores 2x Primary and Secondary Ammo Pick Up Amount every 15s for 60s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetAmmoDrop.descriptionEn: Restores 2x Primary and Secondary Ammo Pick Up Amount every 15s for 60s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetAmmoDrop.descriptionZh: 每 15 秒恢复 2 倍主要和次要弹药拾取量，持续 60 秒。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetAutoHack.name: Override
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetAutoHack.description: Ordis hacks into enemy systems and disrupts security protocols for a short period.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetAutoHack.descriptionEn: Ordis hacks into enemy systems and disrupts security protocols for a short period.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetAutoHack.descriptionZh: Ordis 入侵敌方系统，暂时中断敌人的安保系统协议。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetBarrage.name: Carpet Bomb
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetBarrage.description: Ordis drops bombs in a line from your position to the beacon you placed.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetBarrage.descriptionEn: Ordis drops bombs in a line from your position to the beacon you placed.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetBarrage.descriptionZh: Ordis 会从你的位置直线到信标的距离内投下炸弹。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetBlackHole.name: Vortex
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetBlackHole.description: Creates a whirling mass of energy that violently attracts nearby enemies, crushing their atoms into a tiny spec of matter.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetBlackHole.descriptionEn: Creates a whirling mass of energy that violently attracts nearby enemies, crushing their atoms into a tiny spec of matter.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetBlackHole.descriptionZh: 创造一个大规模旋转的能量，猛烈牵引附近敌人，粉碎他们的原子成微小物质。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetGoldenIns.name: Orokin Eye
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetGoldenIns.description: Ordis scans the area for rare items.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetGoldenIns.descriptionEn: Ordis scans the area for rare items.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetGoldenIns.descriptionZh: Ordis 扫描该区域以寻找稀有物品。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetKahl.name: Kahl Beacon
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetKahl.description: Calls Kahl and a retinue of his Brothers to assist you for a limited time. Subsequent uses heal Kahl's squad and add an additional Brother.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetKahl.descriptionEn: Calls Kahl and a retinue of his Brothers to assist you for a limited time. Subsequent uses heal Kahl's squad and add an additional Brother.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetKahl.descriptionZh: 召唤卡尔和他兄弟的随从们在限定的时间内协助你战斗。后续使用可以治疗卡尔的小队并为你增加一个额外的兄弟。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetMedStatio.name: Med-Tower
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetMedStatio.description: Ordis delivers a Med-Tower to restore health to nearby allies.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetMedStatio.descriptionEn: Ordis delivers a Med-Tower to restore health to nearby allies.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetMedStatio.descriptionZh: Ordis 配送一座治疗塔，可恢复附近友军的生命值。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetShield.name: Snow Globe
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetShield.description: Frost deep freezes any vapor and moisture in the area, creating a protective sphere with brief invulnerability to boost its strength.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetShield.descriptionEn: Frost deep freezes any vapor and moisture in the area, creating a protective sphere with brief invulnerability to boost its strength.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetShield.descriptionZh: 冻结周围所有水气与水分，制造出能用来防御的球形冰罩；冰罩生成时有短暂的无敌时间，此时敌人对冰罩造成的伤害能强化冰罩的耐久度；在相同位置重复施放冰罩可强化其耐久度。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetStun.name: Dreamers
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetStun.description: Nora sends enemies to dreamland with a calming tune.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetStun.descriptionEn: Nora sends enemies to dreamland with a calming tune.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetStun.descriptionZh: 诺拉以平静的曲调将敌人送到梦境。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetTurret.name: Sentry Gun
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetTurret.description: Ordis delivers an automatic turret that will fire upon nearby visible enemies.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetTurret.descriptionEn: Ordis delivers an automatic turret that will fire upon nearby visible enemies.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetTurret.descriptionZh: Ordis 会投放一门全自动炮台来打击附近视野内的敌人。
